name: Audity DJ
author: Audity
description: The talking DJ for the Audity app, on Navidrome, Jellyfin or Plex: Theo's lines from a bank of clips made ahead, with only the names said on this server, only while a DJ session is on, and what the DJ remembers for each account, shared by all your devices.

versions.changelog: The DJ's voice stays loaded once it's downloaded, so it's ready the moment you start the DJ, even after the app was closed, and it starts again on its own should it ever stop. A line the app needs right away (the DJ button's, a skip's) is made before the lines for songs further ahead, and a closed session's waiting lines are let go. The page lists the last lines asked and how each was made. Names are said a little quicker, on Pocket TTS's own single thread. For the app: the bank's sentences at /app/bank.

The DJ talks from Theo's bank: about 5,900 sentences made ahead, played as clips, so most lines are ready at once. Only the names of songs, artists and albums are said on this server, by Pocket TTS (Kyutai, CC-BY-4.0) in Theo's voice, in about a second; a line never waits more than a few seconds for them. Tap Download the Voice once (about 1.5 GB). Your earlier voice talks until it's in, and can be removed after. While the bank is the voice, the DJ is Theo.

The plugin's page works again: in 1.3.0 a mistake in its script left it showing … with no way to download the voice. The page also fills in at once, not after several seconds, and no longer keeps the server busy while it's open.

A new voice, NeuTTS Air (Neuphonic, Apache-2.0), about three times quicker on a processor, so a line is ready well before its song: tap Download the Voice again (3.4 GB). Theo is a new, deeper and cleaner voice. Your earlier voice stays until the new one is in, and can be removed after. A colon in a line now gets a full stop's pause, so a name after it no longer runs on. A take the voice says nothing in is made again, not the line lost.
Lines made faster again: the voice's language model no longer works out word guesses it never uses, about half its work a step, with the sound exactly the same.
Lines made about twice as fast in the voice's flow head, its weights in 8 bits, with the sound kept (the language model, which sets the words and their timing, stays in full precision).
Try a Line says it in the voice picked, those added for one account too, and shows where the time went on this server: loading the voice, speaking, and checking.
A cleaner page in AudioMuse-AI's own style: each voice's name, description and account can be edited, as Audity shows them, and its clip played from its row.
Lines at the voice's full quality (44.1 kHz) for the Audity builds that play it; earlier builds still get 24 kHz.

Jellyfin and Plex accounts sign in too; the voices are named Theo and Juno; lines said before are kept and sent at once; a line is sent the moment it's made; songs that sound alike for the server you signed in to; the crackle between pauses fixed; the page's downloads and voices kept to AudioMuse-AI's admins.
First release: the DJ's voice (Ming-3.0-tts 0.5B on the processor), two voices and your own, lines checked with speech-to-text, and the DJ's memory per Navidrome account.
